items.question: How much is a couples massage in Seminyak?
items.answer: A couple Balinese massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 319.000 for two for 1 hour, IDR 479.000 for 1.5 hours and IDR 659.000 for 2 hours, with two therapists side by side in a private couples room. Couple packages start at IDR 625.000 for two. All prices are for both guests together; home service adds IDR 150.000 for two therapists in the Seminyak area.

items.question: Is a couples massage only for romantic couples?
items.answer: No. At Spa Bali Moon a couples massage simply means two people having treatments side by side, each with their own therapist. Friends, siblings, parents with adult children and other family members book it too.

items.question: Are we in the same room for a couples massage?
items.answer: Yes. With a couples massage at Spa Bali Moon, both guests receive their treatments side by side with two therapists in the same private treatment room at our Seminyak spa, or during the same home service appointment at your villa or hotel. Home service costs an extra IDR 150.000 for two therapists in the Seminyak area.

items.question: Can we each choose a different pressure?
items.answer: Absolutely. In a couples massage at Spa Bali Moon, each guest has their own consultation before the treatment begins, allowing pressure levels and focus areas to be adjusted individually. One of you can have gentle pressure while the other has firmer pressure, side by side in the same private room or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Can we each have a different treatment?
items.answer: It depends on the package: in some, each guest can have a different massage. Our couples massages come in Balinese, traditional, deep tissue and warm candle styles; tell us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 what you'd each like and we'll suggest a combination.

items.question: Is a couples massage good for a honeymoon?
items.answer: Yes. A couples massage is one of Spa Bali Moon's most popular treatments for honeymoons, anniversaries, birthdays and other special occasions. You can enjoy it side by side in a private room at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: Which treatments can we have as a couple?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon's couple massages are Balinese, traditional, deep tissue and warm candle massage, each for two guests side by side. The best choice depends on the pressure you both prefer and how you want to feel afterwards: Balinese is gentle to medium, traditional and deep tissue are firmer, and warm candle uses warm oil and smooth strokes.

items.question: Can we have a couples massage at our villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. For a couples massage at your villa or hotel, Spa Bali Moon sends two therapists to your accommodation so you can relax side by side. In the Seminyak area, a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist applies, so IDR 150.000 for two, on top of the treatment price. Your therapists bring fresh linen, oils and everything the massage needs.

items.question: What is included in a couples spa package?
items.answer: Spa Bali Moon has four couple packages, each priced for two guests. Package A is a 1-hour Balinese massage plus a 30-minute ear candle (IDR 625.000 for two). Package B is a 1-hour Balinese massage plus a 1-hour Bali Moon Facial (IDR 699.000). Packages C and D use the warm candle massage instead (IDR 845.000 and IDR 919.000).

items.question: Can we book a couples massage over Christmas and New Year?
items.answer: Yes. Spa Bali Moon is open daily from 9am to 11pm, and holiday weeks are busy in Seminyak, so message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 a few days ahead. You can relax side by side in a private room at our spa or at your villa (IDR 150.000 for two therapists in the Seminyak area).

items.question: How long does a couples massage take?
items.answer: A couple Balinese massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 1 hour (IDR 319.000 for two), 1.5 hours (IDR 479.000) or 2 hours (IDR 659.000). Couple packages, which add an ear candle or a facial, start at IDR 625.000 for two.

items.question: Can we each ask for a female or male therapist for our couples massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us each guest's preference when you book on WhatsApp and we'll arrange two therapists to match, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
